instagram.caption:
Eleven bottles, each a third full.
The Cleaning Supply Zone in the Hall Closet. Holds the products you clean with, grouped so you carry the right handful to the right room.

What done looks like:
1. Two or three caddies
2. Each labeled on the end with the room it serves
3. Every bottle wearing its original label
4. Ammonia products on separate shelves

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success cleaning supply zone.
